title: TOP-bank DS2 write protection
user_description: Protects the backup TOP bank from ordinary DS2 full writes while retaining calibration writes and Soft-BSL.
description: TOP-build-only resident DS2 classifier guard. Uses the existing B0 rejection before program erase, programming, or E740/E743 and EEPROM dirty-state changes. Redirects only the application full-write jump-table pointer to the guarded worker, so the first request returns normally. Allows calibration-class requests and the stock class-0 finalizer. Reuses unreachable classifier bytes; no added RAM, cave, listener, or AMD/Soft-BSL payload changes. Offline emulator qualification does not imply powered testing.
